title: PUBLIC SAFETY COMMITTEE REPORT AND BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the acceptance of a Fiscal Year 2025-26 Victim Assistance Program (VAP)…
text:
[Council File 26-1176]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
PUBLIC SAFETY COMMITTEE REPORT AND BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the acceptance of a Fiscal Year 2025-26 Victim Assistance Program (VAP) grant sub-award from the County of Los Angeles to support the City Attorney's Office Victim Assistance Program.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. AUTHORIZE the City Attorney, or designee, to:
a. Retroactively accept the grant award in the amount of $2,178,586 from the County of Los Angeles for the period of October 1, 2025 through September 30, 2026.
b. Execute the grant award agreement between the County of Los Angeles and the City Attorney's Office, subject to the approval of the City Attorney.
c. Prepare Controller instructions for any necessary technical adjustments, subject to the approval of the City Administrative Officer, and AUTHORIZE the Controller to implement the instructions.
2. AUTHORIZE the Controller to:
a. Establish a receivable within Fund No. 368, Department No. 12, in the amount of $2,178,586 from the County of Los Angeles.
b. Establish Appropriation Account No. 12E310 within Fund No. 368/12, Victim Assistance Program Y26/27, in the amount of $2,178,586.
c. Upon receipt of grant funds and approval of grant expenses, transfer up to $74,166 from Fund No. 368/12, Account No. 12E310, Victim Assistance Program FY26/27 to Fund No. 100/12, Account No. 001010, Salaries General, to reimburse for salary expenses.
d. Upon receipt of grant reimbursements and approval of expenses, transfer up to $690,000 from Fund No. 368/12, Account No. 12E310, Victim Assistance Program FY26-27 to Fund No. 100/12, Revenue Source Code No. 5346, Related Cost Reimbursement – Grants, to reimburse fringe benefits and related costs during the grant period.
e. Transfer $1,340,834 from Fund No. 368/12, Account No. 12E310, Victim Assistance Program FY 26/27 to Fund No. 100/12, Revenue Source Code No. 5427, Reimbursement from Grants, to reimburse for salary costs incurred.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The City Administrative Officer reports that the total program cost of the Fiscal Year 2025-26 Victim Assistance Program is $2,291,717 of which $2,178,585 will be reimbursed by the County of Los Angeles, from a formula grant awarded by the California Office of Emergency Services. The General Fund contribution is $113,131 in related costs (CAP 42) which is included in the City Attorney's 2026-27 Adopted Budget. Financial policies The City Administrative Officer reports that the recommendations comply with the statement City's Financial Policies in that the grant funds are fully reimbursing the General Fund for grant-eligible activities.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
